findings.summary: Collapsible/composite mount reads computed style in a layout effect and forces a style recalculation. Performance only.
hiddenUntilFound panels render plain hidden in server HTML. Gallery does not use hiddenUntilFound or SSR.
data-starting-style not applied at opening animation; fixed. m3 has no collapsible animation.

notChecked: Reddit, Hacker News and blog posts (not searched; only GitHub issue search API queried for mui/base-ui, shadcn-ui/ui, radix-ui/primitives)

differences.reference: Root is 82px tall. The closed CollapsibleContent stays in the DOM with the hidden attribute, so Tailwind space-y-2 (margin-bottom on :not(:last-child)) still gives the 'repo/one' row an 8px bottom margin.
differences.branch: Root is 74px tall. Base UI unmounts the closed panel, so 'repo/one' becomes the last child and loses the 8px margin. Content below the demo (List section) sits 8px higher. Open state is identical (166px).
differences.how: Open /gallery#components, scroll to #collapsible, compare document.querySelector('#collapsible [data-slot=collapsible]').getBoundingClientRect().height (82 vs 74), or compare the gap under 'repo/one' in screenshots.

differences.reference: Closed panel div is present with hidden and style --radix-collapsible-content-height/width.
differences.branch: Closed panel is not rendered at all (keepMounted is false by default); open panel gets --collapsible-panel-height: auto.
differences.how: Run document.querySelector('#collapsible [data-slot=collapsible-content]') while closed: element on reference, null on branch.

differences.reference: Root, trigger and panel emit data-state=open|closed.
differences.branch: Root and panel emit data-open / data-closed; trigger emits data-panel-open when open and nothing when closed. No data-state. Nothing in src selects on data-state for collapsible, but external consumers would break.
differences.how: Inspect attributes of root, trigger and panel in each build.

differences.branch: Trigger has an explicit tabindex=0 (button type=button and aria-expanded are the same). Behaviour is identical in practice.
differences.how: Inspect the trigger's attributes in each build.

apiChanges: asChild becomes render: <CollapsibleTrigger render={<Button variant="ghost" size="icon-sm" aria-label="toggle" />}><ChevronsUpDownIcon /></CollapsibleTrigger> (children move out of the Button). Not committed.
Prop types become CollapsiblePrimitive.Root.Props / Trigger.Props / Panel.Props; onOpenChange receives (open, eventDetails). Gallery uses setOpen directly, which still works.
notes: Checked on reference vs local build (port 5310, swap applied then reverted): closed and open screenshots at 1280 wide, mouse click, Tab/Shift+Tab focus ring (identical), Space toggle (identical), open/close height timeline sampled every 40ms (both instant, no animation, 166px open). Effective viewport width stayed 1280 after resize_window (innerWidth never changed), so 390x844 was not checked. Gates not run because the component was not switched. Reduced motion not checked (no animation in either build).
reasonNotMoved: The base-nova registry file (https://ui.shadcn.com/r/styles/base-nova/collapsible.json) differs from radix-nova, and the swap changes layout: Base UI unmounts the closed panel while Radix keeps it hidden, so the gallery demo is 8px shorter when closed (74px vs 82px) because space-y-2 no longer applies to the row above the panel, and data-state hooks become data-open/data-closed. Retry by passing keepMounted on CollapsibleContent (this keeps the hidden element and should restore the 82px height; untested here) or by accepting the 8px change, and re-run the comparison.
